item.title: Self-Hosted VLAN Management Platforms: NetBox vs Nautobot vs LibreNMS
item.description: Virtual LAN (VLAN) management is a foundational requirement for any organization operating a switched network infrastructure. As networks grow from dozens to hundreds of VLANs, tracking assignments, trunk configurations, and access port mappings becomes impractical without dedicated tooling. This guide compares three self-hosted platforms for VLAN management: NetBox, Nautobot, and LibreNMS.
